species.name: Bushtit
species.regionalSummary: Year-round on the coastal slope; no home abundance claim.
species.lengthCaveat: Exact range displayed by Cornell ID page at access; no anatomical measurement performed on art.
species.diagnostics: Tiny plump large-headed long-tailed gray/brown bird, short stubby bill; Pacific/local darker brown crown, adult male dark eye; no black chickadee cap or white cheek patch.

species.name: Bewick's Wren
species.regionalSummary: Year-round coastal-slope shrub habitats. San Diego taxon described with dark chocolate upperparts and dark central tail, muted barring.
species.diagnostics: Slender brown/gray wren, bold white eyebrow, fine slightly downcurved bill, strikingly long cocked tail with restrained barring/tip marks; gray-white underside.

species.name: White-crowned Sparrow
species.regionalSummary: Primarily cool-season visitor in target San Diego lowlands. Adult Gambel's-type art proposed; no live abundance claim.
species.diagnostics: Large gray/brown sparrow, adult black-white longitudinal crown stripes, small pink/pale-orange bill, pale lores, plain pale-gray unspotted breast, long tail, brown back streaks and wingbars.
